answer: Concrete mechanism: bonded attestation plus random cross-audit. Each identity deposits a small bond before attesting, and a rotating jury replays a random sample of every attestation. A sybil cluster must post one bond per fake identity while the audit budget stays fixed, so attacker cost grows linearly and return flattens. A forged haven of ten thousand puppets becomes a sable shadow on the ledger instead of leverage. The rule is basalt-hard: volume pays linearly, verification pays logarithmically.
